title: Photography: Imagine by John Lennon | 1971
content:
The portrait photography for the cover of John Lennon’s second solo album Imagine took place on 28 May 1971.

The shoot took place on the south lawn of Lennon’s Tittenhurst Park home. The photographer was his assistant Dan Richter.

Afterwards, the backing track for ‘Oh My Love’ and overdubs for ‘Gimme Some Truth’ were recorded.
